title: Junior IT Operations Administrator
description:
We’re looking for a Junior IT Operations Administrator to provide frontline IT support to Hootsuite owls and solve day-to-day technology problems. This is a hybrid role that supports the service desk, deploying hardware while gaining exposure to identity, endpoint management, and IT automation. The Junior IT Operations Administrator will support Hootsuite’s AI transformation, working to enhance how the organization adopts and operationalizes AI tools. This role is in-person based from either our Vancouver or Toronto Office. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

  • Service Operations 
    • Own and resolve tickets in the Helpdesk queue, documenting solutions in the ticketing system, and following up with clients through to full resolution 
    • Build, configure, and deploy laptops and peripherals for new and existing users 
    • Support hardware procurement, logistics, and asset management 
    • Set up, install, modify, configure, and maintain desk hardware in the office 
  • Platform & Systems
    • Create and decommission accounts for new hires, contractors, temps, and exiting employees, following the defined procedures in h connected systems 
    • Rotate through structured, mentored exposure to core platforms: identity and SSO basics, Jamf endpoint workflows, and asset automation 
    • Support Hootsuite’s AI enablement: assist with provisioning and supporting AI tools, and help owls adopt them effectively 
    • Assist Infrastructure and Systems teammates on platform projects, building hands-on familiarity with the tools behind frontline support 
  • Create tickets and move work through the agile workflow as it completes 
  • Ensure team documentation remains current as processes and stakeholder needs change 
  • Assist in departmental projects that require Helpdesk support and resources
  • Perform on-call duties as needed based on the global schedule 
  • Perform other related duties as assigned 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED: 

  • 1 year of experience troubleshooting basic to advanced Mac problems 
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows OS problems 
  • Working knowledge and understanding of Google Admin and Google Workspace apps 
  • Foundational understanding of, or clear eagerness to learn, identity and access concepts (Active Directory, Single Sign On) 
  • Experience with endpoint management 
  • ACMT course an asset, as we’re predominantly a Mac shop 
  • Experience working in an agile environment is considered an asset
  • Problem Solving: uses an organized and logical approach to find solutions to complex problems. Looks beyond the obvious to understand the root cause of problems
  • Customer Focus: demonstrates a desire to proactively help and serve internal/external customers meet their needs 
  • Open Communication: clearly conveys thoughts, both written and verbally, listening attentively and asking questions for clarification and understanding 
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: works with others to deliver results, meaningfully contributing to the team and prioritizing group needs over individual needs 

WHO YOU ARE: 

  • Solution seeker. You’re focused on tackling new challenges, solving problems, and moving the business forward, and you don’t wait to be asked. 
  • Lifelong learner. You have a growth mindset. You’re here to learn, experiment, seek, apply, and provide feedback, share what works with your team, and move on from what doesn’t. 
  • Resilient adapter. In the face of change and challenges, you bring a thoughtful, calm approach and a focus on finding the new opportunity. 
  • Intentional collaborator. You build positive working relationships across the business, bringing people together to foster new opportunities and to facilitate the efficient flow of information. 
  • Critical challenger. You have the trust in your team to ask difficult questions in order to get to the best end result. 
  • Active communicator. You listen actively and communicate ideas and information clearly, inclusively, and proactively. 
  • Integrated thinker. You look beyond your role and responsibilities to understand how your team’s work drives broader organizational goals. 
  • Accountable owner. You take pride in the work you’re responsible for with a mindset of ultimate accountability and reliability for the outcomes. 
  • Bar-raiser. You step up to help your team grow and succeed, even when that means going beyond what might be expected.

title: Lead, Data Development, AI Platform | Chef(fe), Développement des données – Plateforme d’IA
location: Ottawa, Canada; Toronto, Canada; Waterloo, Canada, Montreal, Quebec, Canada
description:
We are looking for a Lead, Data Development, AI Platform to lead the team building and operating the technical platform behind Hootsuite's Analytics MCP. This includes routing infrastructure, orchestration services, agent infrastructure, and data pipelines that enable reliable AI-driven analysis at scale. You will set technical direction for the team, strengthen engineering practices, and translate target architecture and integration standards into secure, production-grade systems that Data Analytics & AI teams can confidently build on.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will stay close to the code while owning delivery outcomes, engineering quality, and the team's culture of craft and accountability. You will develop strong, well-reasoned recommendations on how the platform and orchestration architecture should evolve, seek approval at the Senior Manager and Director level, and then guide the team through disciplined execution. You will also partner closely with AI Context & Integration and AI Data Architecture to ensure the platform, context layer, semantic layer, and downstream agent workflows operate as one coherent system.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead the design and delivery of the orchestration layer that connects the Analytics MCP platform across its most complex surfaces, including query execution across schemas and models, federated data access between the data warehouse and external source systems, and multi-step agent workflows for cross-functional business processes. 
  • Develop clear technical recommendations for platform and orchestration architecture evolution, align those recommendations with Senior Manager and Director-level direction, and guide the team through disciplined execution within the approved architecture.
  • Own the operational reliability, scalability, quality, and observability standards for core Analytics MCP components, including routing and agent infrastructure. Guide the team to build and operate these systems to production standards, lead incident response and root-cause analysis, and maintain a high code-quality bar through active review, mentorship, and operational discipline.
  • Set and uphold standards for data pipelines built for agent and programmatic consumption rather than traditional dashboard delivery, ensuring the data AI systems depend on is high-quality, well-documented, testable, observable, and dependable at the source.
  • Drive technical build and implementation of internal tooling and agents that improve AI Engineering workflows such as build, deployment, monitoring, diagnostics, and operational support, within the architecture and requirements defined by the Senior Manager.
  • Set the team's engineering standards and ways of working, while developing team members through coaching, regular 1:1s, hands-on code review, and clear feedback that strengthens both technical capability and career growth. Coordinate with the Senior Manager on performance and career development for team members.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Context & Integration and AI Data Architecture to ensure platform, orchestration, and data pipeline changes integrate cleanly with the context layer, semantic layer, governed data models, and downstream agent workflows.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • 8+ years of hands-on software, data, or AI platform engineering experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, including senior IC or technical leadership roles where you influenced technical direction, system design, and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team, including setting technical direction, running code reviews, supporting individual growth, holding accountability for team-level delivery, and balancing hands-on contribution with delegation and unblocking.
  • Strong hands-on programming capability across backend services, APIs, data pipelines, or platform infrastructure, with the ability to build reliable, maintainable systems that meet production standards.
  • Experience building or operating orchestration across systems, such as multi-step process coordination, query execution across multiple data sources, external system integration, workflow automation, or agent workflow orchestration, with the judgment to recommend practical architecture choices.
  • Working knowledge of AI and LLM-based systems, including how agents, tools, context interfaces such as MCP, and orchestration layers work together to produce reliable outputs.
  • Experience building data pipelines for programmatic or agent consumption, with strong attention to source-level quality, documentation, testing, observability, and operational maintainability.
  • Familiarity with platform reliability practices, including observability, monitoring, debugging, security integration, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and production support at scale.
  • Influence and storytelling: Ability to influence without direct authority by using well-reasoned technical recommendations, clear tradeoff analysis, and a compelling narrative that helps others understand the path forward.
  • Inclusive Leadership: Builds inclusive, cohesive teams that apply diverse perspectives to solve complex problems and achieve shared goals.
  • Play to Win: Delivers results through others by establishing clear direction, creating accountability, removing blockers, and helping team members do their best work.
  • Long Range Planning: Identifies the technical, organizational, and dependency risks relevant to long-range goals, and builds integrated plans that translate vision into executable work.
  • Enablement: Challenges and supports others to deliver results while developing new capabilities. Successfully grows the capacity, capability, and confidence of individuals and the broader team.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Solution seeker: You focus on tackling new challenges, solving problems, and moving the business forward, and you do not wait to be asked.
  • Lifelong learner: You bring a growth mindset, actively learn and experiment, seek and apply feedback, share what works with the team, and move on from what does not.
  • Resilient adapter: In the face of change and ambiguity, you bring a thoughtful, calm approach and focus on finding the next best opportunity.
  • Intentional collaborator: You build positive working relationships across the business, bring people together around shared outcomes, and help information move efficiently between teams.
  • Critical challenger: You ask thoughtful, difficult questions in service of reaching the best outcome, while maintaining trust and constructive working relationships.
  • Active communicator: You listen actively and communicate ideas, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs clearly, inclusively, and proactively.
  • Integrated thinker: You look beyond your immediate role and responsibilities to understand how your team's work advances broader organizational goals.
  • Accountable owner: You take pride in the work you are responsible for and bring a mindset of ownership, reliability, and accountability for outcomes.
  • Bar-raiser: You step up to help the team grow and succeed, including when that means going beyond what might be expected.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un·e responsable principal·e, Développement des données, Plateforme IA pour diriger l'équipe responsable de la conception et de l'exploitation de la plateforme technique qui soutient le MCP Analytique de Hootsuite. Cette plateforme comprend l'infrastructure de routage, les services d'orchestration, l'infrastructure des agents et les pipelines de données qui permettent des analyses fiables alimentées par l'IA à grande échelle. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez l'orientation technique de l'équipe, renforcerez les pratiques d'ingénierie et transformerez l'architecture cible ainsi que les normes d'intégration en systèmes sécurisés, prêts pour la production, sur lesquels les équipes Analytique des données et IA pourront s'appuyer en toute confiance.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership technique pratique. Vous demeurerez près du code tout en étant responsable des résultats de livraison, de la qualité de l'ingénierie et de la culture d'excellence et de responsabilisation de l'équipe. Vous élaborerez des recommandations techniques solides et réfléchies sur l'évolution de la plateforme et de l'architecture d'orchestration, obtiendrez l'approbation des Directeurs principaux et Directeurs, puis guiderez l'équipe dans une exécution rigoureuse. Vous collaborerez également étroitement avec les équipes Contexte et intégration IA ainsi qu'Architecture de données IA afin d'assurer une intégration cohérente entre la plateforme, la couche de contexte, la couche sémantique et les flux de travail des agents en aval.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ :

  • Diriger la conception et la livraison de la couche d'orchestration qui relie la plateforme MCP Analytique sur ses aspects les plus complexes, y compris l'exécution de requêtes sur plusieurs schémas et modèles, l'accès fédéré aux données entre l'entrepôt de données et les systèmes sources externes, et les flux de travail d'agents à plusieurs étapes pour les processus d'affaires interfonctionnels.
  • Élaborer des recommandations techniques claires pour faire évoluer l'architecture de la plateforme et de l'orchestration, harmoniser ces recommandations avec l'orientation des Directeurs principaux et Directeurs, puis guider l'équipe dans une exécution rigoureuse conformément à l'architecture approuvée.
  • Assumer la responsabilité de la fiabilité opérationnelle, de l'évolutivité, de la qualité et des normes d'observabilité des composants essentiels du MCP Analytique, y compris l'infrastructure de routage et des agents. Guider l'équipe afin qu'elle conçoive et exploite ces systèmes selon les normes de production, diriger la réponse aux incidents et l'analyse des causes profondes, et maintenir un haut niveau de qualité du code grâce à la révision active, au mentorat et à une discipline opérationnelle rigoureuse.
  • Établir et faire respecter des normes pour les pipelines de données conçus pour la consommation par des agents et des systèmes programmatiques plutôt que pour des tableaux de bord traditionnels, en veillant à ce que les données sur lesquelles reposent les systèmes d'IA soient de grande qualité, bien documentées, testables, observables et fiables dès la source.
  • Diriger le développement technique et la mise en œuvre d'outils internes et d'agents qui améliorent les flux de travail de l'ingénierie IA, notamment en matière de compilation, de déploiement, de surveillance, de diagnostic et de soutien opérationnel, dans le respect de l'architecture et des exigences définies par le Directeur principal.
  • Définir les normes d'ingénierie et les méthodes de travail de l'équipe, tout en favorisant le développement des membres de l'équipe grâce au coaching, à des rencontres individuelles régulières, à la révision pratique du code et à une rétroaction claire qui renforce tant les compétences techniques que le développement de carrière. Collaborer avec le Directeur principal en matière de gestion du rendement et de développement professionnel des membres de l'équipe.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Contexte et intégration IA ainsi qu'Architecture de données IA afin que les changements apportés à la plateforme, à l'orchestration et aux pipelines de données s'intègrent harmonieusement à la couche de contexte, à la couche sémantique, aux modèles de données gouvernés et aux flux de travail des agents en aval.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe qui pourrait vous être confiée.

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN :

  • Au moins 8 ans d'expérience pratique en ingénierie logicielle, en ingénierie des données ou en ingénierie de plateformes IA, ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience, incluant des rôles de contributeur individuel principal ou de leadership technique où vous avez influencé l'orientation technique, la conception des systèmes et les résultats de livraison.
  • Expérience dans la direction ou le mentorat d'une petite équipe d'ingénierie, notamment pour définir l'orientation technique, effectuer des révisions de code, soutenir le développement individuel, assurer la responsabilisation de l'équipe quant aux livraisons, et équilibrer la contribution pratique avec la délégation et la résolution des obstacles.
  • Solides compétences pratiques en programmation dans les services dorsaux (back-end), les API, les pipelines de données ou l'infrastructure de plateformes, avec la capacité de concevoir des systèmes fiables et faciles à maintenir répondant aux normes de production.
  • Expérience de la conception ou de l'exploitation de systèmes d'orchestration entre plusieurs systèmes, notamment la coordination de processus à plusieurs étapes, l'exécution de requêtes sur plusieurs sources de données, l'intégration de systèmes externes, l'automatisation des flux de travail ou l'orchestration des flux de travail d'agents, ainsi que le jugement nécessaire pour recommander des choix d'architecture pragmatiques.
  • Connaissance pratique des systèmes d'IA et des grands modèles de langage (LLM), notamment de la façon dont les agents, les outils, les interfaces de contexte comme le MCP et les couches d'orchestration interagissent pour produire des résultats fiables.
  • Expérience de la conception de pipelines de données destinés à une consommation programmatique ou par des agents, avec une attention particulière à la qualité des données à la source, à la documentation, aux essais, à l'observabilité et à la maintenabilité opérationnelle.
  • Bonne connaissance des pratiques de fiabilité des plateformes, notamment en matière d'observabilité, de surveillance, de débogage, d'intégration de la sécurité, d'analyse des causes profondes, d'optimisation des performances et de soutien à la production à grande échelle.
  • Influence et capacité à raconter une histoire : capacité à exercer une influence sans autorité directe grâce à des recommandations techniques réfléchies, une analyse claire des compromis et un récit convaincant qui aide les autres à comprendre la voie à suivre.
  • Leadership inclusif : crée des équipes inclusives et soudées qui tirent parti de perspectives diversifiées pour résoudre des problèmes complexes et atteindre des objectifs communs.
  • Jouer pour gagner : obtient des résultats par l'entremise des autres en établissant une orientation claire, en créant un climat de responsabilisation, en éliminant les obstacles et en aidant les membres de l'équipe à donner le meilleur d'eux-mêmes.
  • Planification à long terme : cerne les risques techniques, organisationnels et liés aux dépendances qui pourraient compromettre les objectifs à long terme et élabore des plans intégrés qui transforment la vision en réalisations concrètes.
  • Développement des capacités : met les autres au défi et les soutient afin qu'ils obtiennent des résultats tout en développant de nouvelles compétences. Accroît avec succès la capacité, les compétences et la confiance des individus et de l'équipe.

QUI ÊTES-VOUS :

  • Vous êtes orientés vers les solutions: vous êtes déterminé à relever de nouveaux défis, à  résoudre des problèmes et à faire avancer l'entreprise - et vous n'attendez pas qu'on vous le demande.
  • Vous visez un apprentissage en continu: vous avez un état d'esprit de croissance - vous êtes ici pour apprendre, expérimenter, rechercher, appliquer et fournir un retour d'information, partager ce qui fonctionne avec votre équipe et surmonter ce qui ne fonctionne pas.
  • Adaptateur résilient: face aux changements et aux défis, vous adoptez une approche réfléchie et calme et vous vous concentrez sur la recherche de nouvelles opportunités.
  • Un collaborateur déterminé: vous établissez des relations de travail positives dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en rassemblant les gens pour favoriser de nouvelles opportunités et faciliter la circulation efficace des informations.
  • Défi critique: vous faites confiance à votre équipe pour poser des questions difficiles afin d'obtenir le meilleur résultat final.
  • Communicateur actif: vous écoutez activement et communiquez vos idées et vos informations de manière claire, inclusive et proactive.
  • Penseur intégré: Vous allez au-delà de votre rôle et de vos responsabilités pour comprendre comment le travail de votre équipe contribue aux objectifs plus larges de l'organisation.
  • Propriétaire responsable: vous êtes fier du travail dont vous êtes responsable, prônant un état d'esprit de responsabilité et de fiabilité ultimes pour les résultats.
  • Le bar-raiser : vous vous mobilisez pour aider votre équipe à se développer et à réussir, même si cela implique d'aller au-delà de ce qui est attendu.

description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Our Enterprise Customer Success team is responsible for protecting and growing the revenue relationships with 1Password's largest, most strategically significant customers. We are customer-obsessed, commercially rigorous, and committed to building the long-term executive partnerships that make 1Password an indispensable part of every enterprise's identity security strategy. As Enterprise Director of Customer Success, you will lead a team of Enterprise CSMs across experience levels – and own the Enterprise segment's NRR outcomes, engagement model, and team performance. You will be accountable for the full post-sale success motion in the Enterprise segment: retention, expansion pipeline generation, executive business review quality, success plan coverage, and forecasting accuracy. You are a player-coach and organizational architect who shapes how Customer Success operates at scale, develops exceptional talent, and serves as a senior cross-functional partner to Enterprise Sales, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, and Product. This role requires deep customer success expertise, strong commercial acumen, a high standard for operational rigor, and genuine passion for building high-performing teams. Adaptability, executive presence, systems thinking, and a relentless focus on customer and revenue outcomes will define your success. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: Experience & Background • 10+ years in Customer Success, enterprise account management, or a strategic post-sale function in SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of owning NRR and expansion outcomes • 10+ years of people management experience, with demonstrated progression in leading and developing CSMs at multiple levels; experience managing managers is a strong plus • Proven ability to lead Enterprise-focused CS teams through complex renewals, executive stakeholder engagement, and commercial expansion motions • Deep familiarity with CS operating frameworks – success planning, EBR design, risk CTA management, renewal and expansion forecasting – and how they connect to segment-level NRR performance • Strong familiarity with Gainsight and Salesforce; experience using CS platforms to manage team performance, customer health, and pipeline visibility at scale • Background in cybersecurity, identity security, IAM, strongly preferred; former 1Password power user or practitioner is a meaningful advantage Leadership & Team Development • Demonstrated ability to build, develop, and scale high-performing Enterprise CSM teams across levels • Sets and reinforces clear performance standards aligned to the CS KPIs – territory planning, EBRs, expansion pipeline, forecasting hygiene, risk management, CSAT, and advocacy • Structures coaching and development deliberately: formal deal reviews, call debriefs, and development plans that produce measurable improvement in CSM commercial performance • Champions AI capability and enablement adoption across the team; models responsible, high-quality AI-assisted workflows in their own practice • Drives succession planning, hiring strategy, and internal growth paths; builds a team culture of accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement Commercial & Revenue Leadership • Owns the Enterprise segment's NRR targets and the discrete Renewals and Pipeline Generation motions that contribute – including gross retention rate, expansion pipeline volume, amendment win rates, renewal upsell win rates, and forecasting accuracy • Partners with Enterprise AEs to define and evolve the CS-Sales collaboration model: joint account planning, QL handoff standards, pipeline attribution, and deal strategy norms for the segment's most complex accounts • Understands and coaches on multi-stakeholder executive business reviews, C-suite renewal negotiations, multi-year expansion business cases, and competitive retention conversations • Drives forecasting rigor at the team level: maintains forecasting hygiene standards, identifies renewal risks with sufficient lead time, and provides CS leadership with accurate, forward-looking segment visibility • Uses Gainsight and Salesforce to manage segment health, track CTA resolution, monitor expansion pipeline, and report on team-wide RFS KPI performance Strategic & Operational Excellence • Designs, documents, and scales Enterprise CS engagement models, success planning standards, EBR methodologies, and playbooks that improve team-wide performance and create repeatable outcomes • Aligns CS capacity, segment coverage models, and role deployment to ARR growth targets and Enterprise customer complexity • Identifies operating gaps and cross-functional friction; drives structured improvements that reduce risk, accelerate activation, and increase expansion velocity • Contributes to CS OKR development; brings data-backed recommendations that influence CS and GTM strategy, organizational design, and investment priorities • Promotes and models an AI-first approach to commercial execution; builds AI-assisted systems for account intelligence, risk monitoring, and engagement preparation that multiply team capacity at scale Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration • Serves as senior escalation owner for the Enterprise segment's most critical, high-stakes customer situations; partners with cross-functional leaders to drive resolution and ensure learnings are captured and embedded • Trusted partner to Enterprise Sales, Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Support, and Product leadership; aligns stakeholders at all levels, including executive audiences, on customer priorities and segment strategy • Aggregates customer intelligence from the Enterprise book and channels it into GTM positioning, product roadmap input, and CS commercial model design with documented influence on business decisions • Represents the Enterprise CS organization with confidence in leadership forums and strategic planning conversations Communication, Enablement & Influence • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong executive presence across internal and customer-facing audiences • Communicates team performance, renewal risk, expansion opportunity, and strategic priorities with clarity and commercial discipline to CS and GTM leadership • Confident leading with influence rather than authority; navigates organizational ambiguity, drives clarity, and aligns cross-functional partners through expertise and relationship • Champions a culture of enablement, documentation, and shared learning; ensures that high-impact workflows, playbooks, and best practices created within the team are made available and usable across the broader CS organization What you can expect: Onboard & Orient (Month 1) • Develop deep fluency in 1Password's product suite, CS methodology, Enterprise customer profiles, and the commercial motion connecting retention and expansion • Build strong working relationships with your team, key internal partners (Enterprise Sales leadership, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, CS leadership), and the segment's most strategic customer relationships • By the end of Month 1, you will have clear, documented visibility into team health, open renewal risks, expansion pipeline status, and RFS KPI performance across the Enterprise segment Establish the Standard (Month 3) • All direct reports have clear performance expectations, active development plans, and structured coaching rhythms in place • Enterprise CS engagement model is defined or refined: EBR cadence, success plan coverage standards, forecasting hygiene, and CS-Sales collaboration norms are operating with consistency • By Month 3, the team is tracking to NRR targets, forecasting hygiene meets team standards, and expansion pipeline is being sourced and progressed with documented commercial context Drive Performance & Organizational Impact (Month 6) • Enterprise segment NRR is tracking to plan; the team's renewal, expansion, and CSAT outcomes are visible and positive in CS and GTM leadership reporting • Playbooks, AI workflows, and team enablement contributions are in active use and improving measurable outcomes • By Month 6, you are recognized as a strategic cross-functional partner by Enterprise Sales, RevOps, and CS leadership, and your team is developing and performing with clear upward trajectory USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $168,000 USD and $252,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Technical authority and commercial judgement create the bridge between architecture and business outcomes. As a 1Password Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO), you’ll help the world’s largest organizations navigate that bridge while shaping the future of enterprise identity security. The Field CTO is the most senior customer-facing technical advisor within the 1Password Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll influence enterprise technology leaders, accelerate adoption of the 1Password platform and help define how modern organizations secure every sign-in to every application from every device, including AI agents. You’ll partner with executive buyers, enterprise architects, developers and security practitioners to solve some of the industry’s most complex identity and access challenges. You’ll engage in our most strategic customer opportunities, represent 1Password in executive briefings, customer advisory boards, industry events and executive forums, and serve as a trusted advisor to Product, Engineering and GTM leadership. You’ll focus your efforts where executive technical leadership can materially influence customer outcomes, while transforming those experiences into repeatable technical motions that scale across the broader Solutions Engineering organization. Beyond customer engagement, you’ll help scale the technical capabilities of the entire Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll transform customer insights into repeatable playbooks, mentor senior Solutions Engineers, influence product direction and establish technical strategies that improve how we engage enterprise customers around the world. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: - 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, consulting, solutions engineering, enterprise architecture or technical leadership roles. - Demonstrated success influencing executive technology leaders within Fortune 500 organizations. - Deep technical expertise across identity, access management, privileged access, cloud security, developer platforms, SaaS security or AI security. - Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes. - Demonstrated ability to simplify highly complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for executive audiences. - Proven ability to influence enterprise architecture decisions across large, complex organizations. - Experience supporting strategic enterprise sales opportunities and partnering closely with executive sales teams. - Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and modern sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC. - Experience building technical strategies, reusable methodologies or customer engagement frameworks that scale beyond individual contributions. - Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy through customer engagement and market insights. - Proven ability to build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales and executive leadership while influencing without direct authority. - Experience speaking to diverse audiences at industry conferences, executive forums and analyst events. - Willingness to travel up to 50%. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Within your first 12 to 18 months, you will: - Influence the successful outcome of 1Password’s most strategic customer opportunities and executive relationships. - Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering and GTM leadership that shape future platform investments. - Create repeatable technical plays, executive messaging and reference architectures adopted across the global Solutions Engineering organization. - Elevate the technical capabilities of the field through mentorship, thought leadership and executive engagement. - Expand 1Password’s influence across the identity security community through conference speaking, customer advisory boards and industry events. What you can expect: SERVE AS A TRUSTED TECHNICAL ADVISOR TO STRATEGIC CUSTOMERS - Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Chief Architects and technical decision makers across Fortune 500 organizations. - Participate in executive briefings, architecture reviews and strategic workshops to help customers solve complex identity, access and security challenges. - Participate in executive customer meetings where senior technical leadership is needed to build consensus, align C-level priorities with technical teams and accelerate strategic initiatives. - Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, helping account teams navigate architecture discussions, competitive evaluations and executive decision making. - Support our most strategic opportunities by accelerating technical alignment, reducing execution risk and building customer confidence. SHAPE THE FUTURE OF SOLUTIONS ENGINEERING - Build repeatable technical motions, executive messaging, reference architectures and technical playbooks that scale across the global Solutions Engineering organization. - Mentor senior Solutions Engineers and help raise the technical and consultative capabilities of the broader team. - Partner with Sales Leadership, Solutions Engineering Leadership and Enablement to identify emerging technical trends, strategic opportunities and areas for organizational investment. - Develop enablement programs that prepare the field for emerging technologies and evolving customer challenges. - Serve as a technical thought leader across the organization, helping define best practices for enterprise engagement. INFLUENCE PRODUCT STRATEGY - Serve as the executive voice of the field by bringing customer feedback, competitive intelligence and implementation insights directly to Product and Engineering leadership. - Partner with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities, validate emerging capabilities and support early customer adoption programs. - Help translate emerging market trends into actionable product and GTM strategies. REPRESENT 1PASSWORD EXTERNALLY - Speak at conferences, executive events, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings and industry forums. - Develop technical thought leadership through presentations, blogs, webinars, whitepapers and executive content. - Build credibility with customers, industry analysts, strategic partners and the broader security community while strengthening 1Password’s market position. - Be called upon to join high-impact, in-person customer engagements where executive technical leadership can build alignment, accelerate decision-making and strengthen strategic relationships. - Serve as the executive technical face of 1Password for our most strategic customers and partners. - Shape how 1Password engages enterprise organizations around identity security, AI, developer security and modern access management. - Partner directly with executive leadership across Product, Engineering, Marketing and Go-to-Market to influence company strategy. - Help define the future of Solutions Engineering by mentoring technical leaders and building scalable customer engagement models. - Represent 1Password on some of the industry’s biggest stages while helping organizations securely navigate the future of identity. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $228,000 USD and $342,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $228,000 CAD and $342,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. Our approach to work We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs 🩺 Competitive health benefits 🏝 Generous PTO policy Growth and future 📈 RSU program for most employees 💸 Retirement matching program 🔑 Free 1Password account Community 🤝 Paid volunteer days 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 🌎 Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. title: Head of Revenue Operations & AI
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

We're looking for a transformational leader who can use AI to help our teams work smarter and faster, so they can spend more time building real relationships with the independent retailers and brands at the heart of our mission. 

This isn't a traditional Revenue Operations role. Faire has already embraced an AI-first future. We have active initiatives underway, dedicated resources, and strong momentum. We're looking for a leader who can accelerate that journey, rethink what’s possible in today’s world, and help redefine how our Sales and Success teams operate internally and with customers.  If you are someone who values moving fast, iteration over perfection, and trialing new ideas, you’ll fit right in. 

You'll lead a team of approximately 15 spanning multiple subfunctions under Rev Ops including GTM Engineering, Program Management, Enablement, and Analytics. Together, you'll own the systems, tooling, processes, training, and operating rhythms that power our revenue organization while helping shape the future of work through AI.

What you’ll do

Own the GTM Strategy & Execution

  • Set the strategy, goals, and territory design across our sales and success teams -  including how we set targets, prioritize accounts, and allocate resources across motions
  • Own forecasting accuracy and pipeline diagnostics, and build the data and metric standards that the revenue function reports against 
  • Translate business strategy into GTM priorities; make tradeoffs visible and keep the org focused on the highest-leverage work

Lead the AI Roadmap for Revenue

  • Define and evolve the AI vision and roadmap for the revenue org - always anchored to business outcomes
  • Decide where AI and automation belong in how we operate and analyze performance, and where human judgment is required, and build the review processes that make AI output reliable enough to act on
  • Evaluate, build, and validate solutions and tools; this role is hands-on and leading from the front on AI building
  • Measure what actually moved: rep time saved, conversion lift, pipeline quality

Drive Enablement and Adoption

  • Own the enablement function for the revenue org -  translating strategy, tools, new processes and sales skills into how reps and managers actually operate day to day
  • Drive adoption and behavior change when new tools, processes, or AI workflows roll out; building something nobody uses isn't a win

Build and Develop the Team

    • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team with clear ownership, accountability, and career paths
    • Foster a culture of experimentation, high standards, and the willingness to call things that aren't working

We're looking for someone who

Is a Builder

You're a builder at heart, whether that means designing a better workflow, structuring a team from scratch, or prototyping a tool to test an idea. You're curious about what's possible and energized by turning that curiosity into something that actually works for the people using it. You follow AI developments closely and know how to apply them — but you're just as energized by a well-designed process or a sharp insight as you are by a new tool.

Has Exceptional Judgment

You understand where AI can create meaningful leverage and where it can't. You can tell the difference between a solution that saves a rep an hour a week and one that just looks impressive in a demo.  You make thoughtful tradeoffs and focus on what matters most.

Knows Go to Market Deeply

You understand sales and the levers to move outcomes. You don’t just implement a playbook, you dig deep on each motion, ask good questions, form hypotheses, and develop first-principle strategies.

Builds Strong Teams

You raise the performance of the people around you. You coach effectively, are not afraid to have difficult conversations, and help individuals and teams reach their full potential.

Moves Fast and Creates Clarity

You're good at figuring out what matters most, communicating it clearly, and getting things done quickly and effectively. 

Cares about who you are building for 

You care about the mission and the team. You want to build a world where independent retailers thrive and help create vibrant communities. And you get true fulfillment from making the lives and roles of the reps who make that happen better and more impactful.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Management Consulting, or related fields
  • Experience using AI tools and workflows to drive measurable improvements in team productivity or business outcomes
  • Experience building and leading high-performing teams
  • Strong analytical and operational skills
  • Experience in high-growth technology companies preferred

Why Join Faire

AI is creating a once-in-a-generation opportunity to rethink how organizations operate.

At Faire, you'll have the chance to help define the future of AI-enabled work—not just for a technology company, but for the millions of independent retailers and brands whose businesses help shape the character of communities around the world.

If you're excited about building, experimenting, leading change, and creating meaningful impact, we'd love to meet you.

Salary Range

San Francisco: the pay range for this role is $285,000 to $357,500 per year.

description:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Lead Global Partner Program- Channel Operations who will lead translating the Global Partner Program strategy, into operational programs that achieve measurable partner and business outcomes If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Lead Global Partner Program- Channel Operations your key area of responsibility will be to translate the Global Partner Program strategy, into operational programs that achieve measurable partner and business outcomes. This Lead Global Program Manager is a hands-on executor who will build, run, and continuously enhance the partner program's operational backbone. The role involves close coordination with Program Leads in GTM, Referral, Partner Onboarding, and Partner Enablement to ensure execution is consistent, scalable, and aligned with leadership's direction. The ideal candidate is a structured builder and operator who excels at execution, possesses strong commercial and partner program management discipline, and can drive results across a cross-functional partner ecosystem. The role is operational in nature, focused on program execution and delivery rather than partner strategy or partner relationship management.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Design and operationalize partner program frameworks, governance standards, and partner lifecycle processes that scale across a global, multi-motion partner ecosystem

  • Translate program strategy into structured execution plans, operational calendars, and delivery frameworks across multiple partner program pillars

  • Own the day-to-day operational health of the partner program — program compliance, partner communications, process documentation, and governance execution

  • Maintain and evolve partner-facing program guidelines, tier criteria, and operational standards as living assets that reflect current program state

  • Directly produce program outputs — playbooks, frameworks, governance documents, and process standards — as a hands-on executor who builds, not just plans

  • Define and maintain the partner health reporting framework, tracking ecosystem KPIs including partner activation, tier distribution, performance trends, and program compliance across the partner base

  • Build reporting models that surface actionable insights for leadership — translating partner program data into clear analysis of what is driving ecosystem performance

  • Proactively identify operational gaps and program inefficiencies, and bring forward structured recommendations and solutions

  • Serve as the operational backbone across multiple partner program workstreams, ensuring consistent execution standards, connected processes, and shared operational context across program leads

  • Identify and resolve dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and execution gaps across program pillars before they impact delivery

  • Maintain the master program roadmap and operational calendar, coordinating delivery milestones across all workstreams

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure partner program execution is aligned with commercial objectives and go-to-market priorities

  • Collaborate with systems and technology teams to ensure partner-facing platforms and tools accurately reflect program requirements and support partner and internal user needs

  • Serve as the operational subject matter expert on partner program structure, governance, and requirements for internal teams and leadership

  • Drive ongoing communication to revenue-facing teams on partner program positioning, offerings, and joint value propositions

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 10-12+ years of experience 

  • Experience with hyperscale partner programs (AWS Partner Network, Microsoft GPS, Google Cloud Partner Program, Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem) strongly preferred

  • Direct experience working within a partner program, alliance program, or channel program at a technology company — not general program management

  • Experience building and maintaining partner program operational frameworks, governance processes, or partner lifecycle workflows

  • Familiarity with how indirect channel programs are structured: tier systems, scoring models, MDF, deal registration, partner performance metrics

  • Demonstrated track record of executing and delivering impactful programs and tiered partner models — a doer who produces results, not just plans

  • Strong operational and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and maintain quality across all of them

  • Experienced working within strategy set by leadership and translating direction into structured, executable programs

  • Embraces AI and builds workflows, reporting frameworks, and operational models that scale outcomes

  • Commercial acumen with experience contributing to partner revenue and growth targets through operational program levers

  • Technical fluency of AI platforms and demonstrated practical usage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — able to produce clean process documentation, program collateral, and crisp executive-ready updates

  • Collaborative and effective working alongside peer Program Leads without direct authority

  • Telematics experience a bonus

This role is not a fit for candidates with a background primarily in technical program management, software delivery, IT project management, or engineering program management. We are specifically seeking professionals who have worked within partner programs, alliance organizations, or indirect channel program operations — not technology delivery programs.

title: Senior Application Engineer, Workplace Technology
description:
To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu.

To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

The role is part of the IT Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The IT team supports ERP Services, Workplace services, Service-Desk and On-Prem DC Services across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet.  As a Software (Application) Engineer in the newly formed Workplace technology team, you’ll help design, build, and maintain the systems and automations that power Mozilla’s workplace technologies — from collaboration and AI productivity tools to identity and access workflows. You’ll manage day-to-day administration, develop scripts and integrations, and contribute to projects that improve reliability, security, and user experience. This role is hands-on and growth-oriented, offering opportunities to deepen your technical expertise while shaping how Mozillians work and collaborate.

Note: You don’t need to meet every listed qualification to be considered — we value diverse experiences and learning potential.

What you’ll do: 

  • Design, build, and maintain scripts, APIs, and workflow automations that power key workplace systems — collaboration tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian) and identity platforms (Okta).
  • Develop lightweight services or integrations that connect collaboration, GenAI-tools (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) and internal systems, enabling agentic flows (e.g., virtual assistants, workflow agents) that reduce manual work and improve user experience.
  • Implement monitoring, logging and observability for automation and AI workflows; troubleshoot issues and uncover opportunities for reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evolution of secure onboarding, off-boarding, and mover workflows across access, permissions and SaaS tools — with automation and safe agentic handoffs where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with IT, Security, and People teams to ensure identity, data, and compliance standards (SSO, DLP, classification) are deeply embedded through automation and script-driven guardrails.
  • Participate in pilot projects for new AI and productivity capabilities: integrate LLMs & agents, track usage/adoption metrics, build flows that assist users (e.g., knowledge-agent, document summarizer).
  • Contribute to the code-review process, documentation of shared libraries for workflows/agents, and build a library of integration templates for reuse across the team.
  • Partner with senior engineers to modernize workplace systems through scalable architecture, API-first design, and intelligent agentic workflows.

What you'll bring:

  • 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or workplace technology development, with a focus on automation or scripting.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (Java, Go, Python, JavaScript/Apps Script, Bash, PowerShell) and comfortable with RESTful APIs, webhooks, and integration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with SaaS platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian) and interest in agentic/AI workflows (LLMs, agents, prompt pipelines).
  • Understanding of IAM/SSO (Okta, SAML/OIDC/SCIM) or a willingness to grow in this area; experience automating provisioning/access is a plus.
  • Experience or curiosity about CI/CD, workflow orchestration, and building self-service delivery models that leverage agents or automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation and cross-functional communication skills; comfortable collaborating with non-technical partners and translating automation into tangible operational gains.
  • A growth mindset: you embrace learning new AI technologies, care about user experience, and seek to improve systems through intelligent workflows.
  • Interest in building agentic flows (for example: bots that triage tickets, summarize documents, assist user tasks) and integrating them responsibly into workplace systems.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Event Operations Manager who will serve as the strategic bridge between our global events program, long-term market trends, and revenue generation. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

The Senior Event Operations Manager owns the operational engine, data flow, and financial governance that make our events profitable. The primary focus of this role is on advocating for strategic investment, driving partnership value, and providing cross-functional leadership. Operating at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Finance, you will define the event campaign narrative, influence GTM priorities, and serve as the subject matter expert to ensure our events program serves as a scalable driver of business growth.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own the centralized financial tracking for the global events program, ensuring strict alignment with defined spend targets and approved budgets.

  • Manage vendor invoicing, procurement processes, and contract tracking in partnership with the Finance team.

  • Calculate and report on event ROI, cost-per-lead (CPL), and cost-offset targets (e.g., sponsorships and exhibitor fees).

  • Maintain meticulous financial accuracy in the Global Events Calendar and relevant data platforms.

  • Serve as the primary Salesforce administrator for the events team, building and managing all event campaigns, hierarchies, and reporting dashboards.

  • Design and execute pre- and post-event marketing workflows, including email campaigns, landing pages, and automated follow-ups using our Marketing Automation platform (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot).

  • Ensure seamless data synchronization between event registration platforms and Salesforce CRM.

  • Monitor data hygiene, ensuring all event leads are accurately tagged, segmented, and routed to the correct sales representatives in real-time.

  • This role will plan, execute, and manage marketing campaigns to drive brand awareness, customer engagement, and business growth.

  • The role will focus on full-funnel marketing, driving conversions, promoting solutions, and managing demand generation.

  • Own and administer event registration and management platforms.

  • Manage on-site lead retrieval systems, ensuring field teams and sponsors have the technology and training needed to capture prospect data seamlessly.

  • Develop and enhance the process for lead information acquisition, standardizing how data is collected across internal, external, and partner events.

  • Build and maintain centralized dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into event performance, pipeline contribution, and attendee engagement.

  • Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), opportunity influence, and accelerated deal velocity.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Partnerships to align event programming with go-to-market (GTM) priorities.

  • Implement feedback loops and post-event surveys to measure internal and external stakeholder satisfaction, using data to drive continuous improvement.

  • Cross functional alignment with supporting teams and business functions to optimize processes and global alignment to events systems and tools.

  • Leverage event performance data to identify long-term (1-5 year) opportunities and industry trends, proactively contributing to segment strategy during planning cycles.

  • Evolve association and sponsor relationships from transactional vendor management to high-value strategic partnerships that enhance company visibility and influence.

  • Facilitate a recurring feedback loop between Sales, Product Marketing, and the Events team. Act as the strategic owner of the event campaign narrative, ensuring that event messaging is aligned with GTM priorities and business objectives.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for event intelligence. Instead of simply reporting on ROI, analyze how event participation influences deal velocity and buyer intent, using these insights to advocate for resource allocation and strategic shifts.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 8–10 years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Event Operations, specifically within a high-volume, high-budget B2B environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in a related field may be substituted.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Salesforce (campaign management, lead routing, reporting, and dashboard creation). Salesforce Administrator certification is a strong plus.

  • Strong working knowledge of marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot) and how they integrate with CRM systems.

  • Hands-on experience managing event software and registration platforms (e.g., Cvent, Bizzabo, Splash, RainFocus).
