location: Oakville, Ontario - Canada; Toronto, Ontario - Canada; Waterloo, Ontario - Canada
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
 
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. 

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Lead Embedded Developer who will drive the technical direction of the Software in the Loop (SiL) team and evolve the simulation framework that validates GO device firmware at scale. In this role, you will architect solutions, mentor developers, and ensure that Geotab's embedded systems testing infrastructure keeps pace with a rapidly growing product portfolio. If you love embedded systems, simulation technology, and technical leadership — and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Lead Embedded Developer, your key area of responsibility will be owning technical initiatives and defining the architecture for the Software in the Loop simulation platform a proprietary Golang-based framework that simulates Geotab GO devices both locally for individual developers and at cloud scale for overnight regression runs across hundreds of virtual vehicles. You will make architectural decisions, drive GitLab CI/CD pipeline management, lead sprint planning in collaboration with your hiring manager, and spearhead upcoming initiatives including hardware-in-the-loop integration and virtual-twin tooling for Engineering Support teams. You will mentor team members, uphold technical best practices, perform peer code reviews, and maintain design documentation to ensure long-term code quality and reuse.

You will work closely with your hiring manager and an architect to co-define focus areas each two-week Scrum cycle, and engage cross-functionally with the Vehicle Systems Engineering group in Waterloo for data inputs, the Engineering Support team as a key consumer of the simulation tooling, and the cloud infrastructure team that supports the platform's cloud layer. To be successful in this role you will be a technically credible communicator who can translate complex embedded systems and architectural decisions clearly for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. In addition, the successful candidate will bring intellectual curiosity, strong ownership instincts, and the ability to understand adjacent domains beyond their own direct technical focus.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Architect and validate firmware simulation solutions from requirements through to production, owning technical initiatives end-to-end.Lead technical projects across the team's roadmap, including hardware-in-the-loop integration and Engineering Support virtual-twin tooling.

  • Provide advanced technical mentorship and take ownership of the quality and deliverables of developers within the team.

  • Perform quality assurance through peer review, ensuring test coverage, enforcing coding standards, identifying potential bugs, and aligning implementations with requirements.

  • Identify key areas of architecture improvement and contribute to the team roadmap, breaking large engineering efforts into parallel-executable pieces.

  • Define and maintain unit test, integration test, and simulated test frameworks to facilitate test-driven development across the embedded platform.

  • Advise stakeholders and management with data-driven insights and recommendations to improve team direction and execution quality.

  • Contribute to defining strategic direction, planning the roadmap, and synthesizing cross-team feedback to ensure team success.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • Post-secondary Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).

  • 7+ years of hands-on embedded software development experience, with demonstrated progression to a technical lead or architect level.

  • Proficiency in Golang; experience with C/POSIX, embedded Linux, and/or RTOS environments.

  • Experience in developing containerized, microservices environments geared towards scalable cloud deployments.

  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred), scripting languages (Python, Bash), and SQL or BigQuery for device health and data analysis.

  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns common to resource-constrained embedded systems, including multi-threaded and RTOS environments.

  • Experience in software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, or large-scale automated test infrastructure is a strong asset.

  • Must be able to support a hybrid schedule.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
 
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.
 
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
 

Why job seekers choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements
Home office reimbursement program
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program
Online learning and networking opportunities
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

*The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!
 
We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. As a Lead Software Developer your key area of responsibility will be designing, building and maintaining efficient, reusable, reliable code to develop high throughput, performance critical, scalable applications. You will be responsible for leading the development of scalable code, prototypes, and PoCs, taking ownership of complex, long-term projects, and ensuring timely delivery. You will need to work closely with other software developers, engineers, internal technical teams, cross-functional partners, product managers, and external stakeholders.

To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player and mentor with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working under pressure in a flat organization, and possessing excellent verbal and written communication skills to document complex technical systems. In addition, the successful candidate will have expert technical competence in design and architecture, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, and strong project management capabilities to manage multiple fast-changing priorities simultaneously. 

How you'll make an impact:

  • Independently and proactively identify key areas of architecture improvement, including preparing proposals on achieving the improvements.

  • Lead, oversee and plan the development of scalable code, prototypes, minimum viable products and PoCs.

  • Take ownership of complex/ long-term projects and contribute to their implementation, including defining scope, requirements, communicating project progress, challenges and solutions, while ensuring timely delivery.

  • Collaborate with other development teams on design and implementation of features spanning multiple products.

  • Conduct comprehensive testing and code reviews to ensure that code quality is maximized and best-practices are followed.

  • Contributes to defining strategic direction, planning the roadmap, and synthesizing feedback to ensure team success.

  • Serve as a cross functional resource across team/department and products to contribute to solving technical issues in development.

  • Builds relationships and serve as a technical point of contact partnering with stakeholders including customers, product managers, cross-functional partners, and external partners and other internal team members.

  • Mentor other developers on the team and work with the team leads to set the direction of the team and guide key stakeholders on execution choices and trade-offs, and advise manager with insights and recommendations to improve the team.

  • Appropriately document system design and architecture such that it is easy to understand, maintain and extend.

  • Support Geotab global strategic initiatives.

  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotating schedule (if applicable).

  • Independently evaluate technical solutions, while contributing to the team roadmap.

  • Present and lead technical discussions and training at the department wide level.

  • Stay up to date on emerging technologies and changes in best practices in the development field and present them to senior leadership for consideration.

  • Write complex scalable, high quality and secure software in a variety of programming languages and environments, such as C#, JavaScript, SQL.

  • Serve as a domain expert (ex GBQ), consulting in the area of expertise for the department and across the organization.

What you'll bring to this role

  • 10 - 12 years of experience as a Software Developer using object-oriented programming to build scalable applications.

  • Post-secondary Diploma/Degree with specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience.

  • Proven technical expertise in design, architecture, and optimizing databases (e.g., MySQL), with hands-on experience using Python, Google Compute Engine, and Google BigQuery.

  • Strong database proficiency with SQL Server and Postgres database design, optimization, and query writing.

  • Deep frontend knowledge encompassing languages and libraries (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, XML, ES6, jQuery), JavaScript frameworks (Angular, React, Node.js, Vue.js), and UI/UX design.

  • Proficiency in Git or other distributed source control tools, including resolving merge conflicts and managing branches.

  • Demonstrated leadership success in the mentorship and development of employees, including serving as a mentor for interns over several years.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, research open-ended design problems, and work effectively under pressure.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

The Firefox Product Marketing team works closely with Product, Marketing, Creative and other cross-functional partners to drive acquisition, activation, engagement and retention across the entire user journey. The Lifecycle Marketing Operations Manager will serve as the operational anchor for Firefox Mobile marketing execution. They will translate product marketing and growth strategies into reliable, repeatable execution across App Store Optimization (ASO), lifecycle programs, product launches and other priority growth initiatives. They will also improve execution quality and team scalability by developing stronger processes, automation and AI-assisted workflows.

What you’ll do: 

  • Coordinate and execute ASO initiatives, including metadata updates, creative experiments and app store events, in collaboration with Product Marketing and our external agency.
  • Translate approved lifecycle campaign briefs into executable plans and support hands-on campaign execution across key moments in the user journey.
  • Support the execution of product launches and other priority growth initiatives by coordinating workstreams, cross-functional handoffs and operational follow-through.
  • Own shared localization, quality assurance and operational readiness workflows across supported workstreams, identifying and escalating blockers and risks before they affect delivery.
  • Gather and consolidate performance data and operational learnings from campaigns and experiments to support reporting, synthesis and future optimization decisions.
  • Develop scalable processes, automation and AI-assisted workflows—including solutions using Claude Code and Cowork—to improve execution consistency and reduce coordination overhead.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing operations or a similar role.
  • Experience coordinating and executing multi-step marketing programs across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, timelines and dependencies.
  • Strong operational judgment, organization and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize effectively and work independently.
  • Experience creating repeatable processes, workflows and documentation that improve execution quality and efficiency.
  • Commitment to our values: 
    • Play to win
    • Build for people first
    • Engage evidence over ego
    • Decide and deliver
    • Ship, learn, repeat

What will help you stand out:

  • Experience with mobile growth or ASO, including metadata optimization and creative experimentation.
  • Comfort working with performance data, including campaign measurement, experiment analysis and reporting.
  • Experience building automated and AI-assisted workflows using Claude Code, Cowork, or similar tools.

  • Rich medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. description:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
 
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. 

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Manager, Product Marketing who will lead a team of market facing experts to drive the growth and adoption of your product portfolio. You will be a key contributor to the product strategy and roadmap, responsible for developing compelling positioning and messaging. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Manager, Product Marketing, you will own the go-to-market strategy, leading cross-functional teams to ensure successful product launches and campaigns. You will mentor your team, foster a culture of market expertise, and serve as a strategic partner to Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership, ultimately owning the market success of your products.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead and mentor the team to tell the product story in a simple, clear, and compelling way, ensuring consistent and differentiated messaging that effectively shares Geotab’s products with the world. Oversee the development and refinement of product positioning and messaging frameworks.

  • Partner with Product Marketing Management (PMM) leadership and other senior team members to guide the team in building the holistic product marketing roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities. Establish and track Key Performance Areas (KPAs) for the team and contribute to defining overall team goals year over year. Develop and champion strategies to achieve the next level of growth through team efforts.

  • Partner with Product Marketing Management (PMM) leadership to actively shape and advance the Product Marketing craft at Geotab. Lead the development and implementation of scalable processes and standards for how the team goes to market and coordinates with internal stakeholders. Oversee the evaluation and management of 3rd party tools or platforms to enhance the capabilities and efficiency of the PMM function.

  • Ensure the team collaborates closely with Product Managers to embody the "voice" of their respective products, possessing comprehensive knowledge of features and capabilities. Guide the team in tailoring messaging and documentation to meet the specific requirements of individual and sales teams.

  • Foster and lead strong collaborative relationships with Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution of product marketing strategies driven by your team. Represent the Product Marketing team in cross-functional leadership discussions.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement leadership to define priorities and oversee the team's creation and delivery of effective training programs and sales tools, equipping the sales team with the knowledge and resources they need to effectively sell the product.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketing Managers, fostering a collaborative and engaged environment. Provide coaching, mentorship, and ongoing feedback while supporting talent management, performance management, resource planning, and professional development. Oversee performance reviews and related HR activities, and continuously improve team processes, policies, and ways of working.

  • Drive the advancement of product, sales, and marketing KPAs by guiding the team's creation of impactful product marketing deliverables (messaging and content). Ensure the team is focused on successful adoption of features and functionality of new releases. Monitor and report on pipeline and lead generation goals in partnership with marketing teams, holding the team accountable for results.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 10+ years  of work experience ideally in Product Marketing in SaaS.

  • 3–5 years in a supervisory role.

  • Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree specialization in Engineering, Business/Marketing, Computer Science or a related field highly valued.

  • Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes. 

  • Solid understanding of product development and marketing principles.    

  • Experience in developing sales tools and training programs.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

  • Deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate those needs into compelling product marketing strategies.

  • Experience coaching, managing and developing team members.    

  • Ability to establish and optimize product marketing processes and standards. 

  • Innovative thinker with a knack for developing unique marketing campaigns and strategies.

  • Deep understanding of customer needs and motivations.    

  • Expertise in conducting in-depth competitive analysis and developing strategies to differentiate products.    

  • Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, and industry influencers.

description: ABOUT FLOAT Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple. At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success. OUR PRODUCT Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank. Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada. AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Marketing & Growth Operations Manager to build on the early foundations of our marketing operations function. You'll partner with our Head of Growth Marketing, our Growth PM, and the broader RevOps org to enable pipeline generation and revenue growth. To do this, you will own the evolution of marketing attribution, lead-scoring and nurture processes, and close the gap between our self-serve and sales-managed motions. Your first project: audit the marketing and self-serve funnels end-to-end to understand what's measured, what's broken, and where the gaps are. Once that diagnostic picture is clear, you'll move into solutioning — measurement, attribution, and forecasting. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Own and manage marketing attribution, building the systems needed to see where marketing spend is winning, losing, and where to invest next. - Build and ship a product-qualified-lead (PQL) scoring model that hands self-serve users to Sales with a process Sales can act on - Identify and close root causes of funnel leakage across the self-serve and inbound marketing motions — with before/after evidence, not just a diagnosis. - Move cost/efficiency metrics — CAC, CAC payback, cost-per-lead, cost-per-qualified-opportunity — through real experiments and interventions you run yourself. - Own the on-ramps and off-ramps between the self-serve and sales-managed funnel, in partnership with our Growth PM. - Partner with our BDR team to improve outbound efficiency and automate list management. - Bring order to a marketing tech stack that today spans HubSpot, Salesforce, and Braze — improving orchestration between systems rather than working around the gaps. - Become a trusted source of truth on funnel performance for Growth, Marketing, and Sales Ops. ABOUT YOU HERE'S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT: - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users. - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what's best for the business, not just your role. - You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energized by building from 0 to 1. You're not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go. - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You're hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do. - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work. - You Win as a Team. You're a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger. IN ADDITION TO LIVING OUR VALUES, YOU BRING: - 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or growth operations. - Hands-on, practical experience building, fixing, or owning multi-touch attribution models — not just conceptual familiarity with different attribution approaches. - A track record of building lead or lifecycle scoring models, ideally one you can speak to with real numbers (e.g., pipeline generated, SQLs surfaced). - Fluency with CAC, CAC payback, cost-per-lead, and cost-per-qualified-opportunity, with an example of directly owning work that moved one of these metrics. - Comfortable navigating a marketing tech stack and building or owning dashboards and reporting yourself, rather than only consuming what a data team builds. - Experience in SaaS environments where self-serve and sales-managed segments coexist. - A systems thinker who also executes — someone who designs the fix and sees it through personally. - Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment with limited existing documentation. THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF: - You want an established, well-documented function to step into rather than build from close to scratch. - You've only worked in an oversight capacity on attribution and haven't built or fixed a model hands-on. - You want a team to manage or lean on — this is a high-autonomy, individual-contributor seat. - You're looking for a narrow, single-channel specialization rather than a broad remit spanning attribution, scoring, systems, and cross-functional partnership. OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole. WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters IN SHORT At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you. We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-boult-b21b2053/ (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Marketing Chief of Staff to keep Cohere's marketing org moving at full speed without coming apart at the seams. You'll report to the VP of Brand and work across the whole function: brand, editorial, design, product marketing, demand generation, and integrated marketing. This is not a strategy-only role, and it isn't a glorified project-management seat either. In any given quarter the org is shipping product launches, field events, partner campaigns, and demand programs in parallel, often across regions and time zones. That pace is the reason the role exists. Your job is to make sure the right work wins when everything feels urgent, that plans turn into shipped work, and that the VP of Brand and the leadership team spend their time leading instead of firefighting. Be clear-eyed about the shape of the work. A lot of it is operational: the planning calendar, the budget, the headcount plan, the weekly business reviews, the cross-functional handoffs that break when nobody owns them. The grind is the job. You should want that part, not tolerate it. One boundary worth naming up front. Marketing Ops owns the systems: the MarTech stack, attribution, scoring, routing, data pipelines, and the reporting everyone runs on. You'll be the heaviest consumer of that work, not the owner of it. If you find yourself rebuilding dashboards or running a tooling migration, something has gone wrong. Your seat is the operating rhythm of the org: meetings, priorities, plans, and the decisions that come out of them. WHO YOU ARE You've run operations inside a fast, high-output B2B marketing org, and you've left it running better than you found it. You know the specific failure mode of a team that's shipping a lot and losing the thread, and you know how to pull it back without slowing everyone down. You understand how marketing actually works, at the level of someone who's done it rather than managed it from a distance. You can talk credibly about how a campaign turns into pipeline, what account-based marketing demands from both sales and marketing before it works, and where demand-gen motions usually break. You don't have to have run every program yourself. You do have to understand them well enough that the people who run them respect your judgment. You're fluent in the numbers. Pipeline math, funnel conversion, budget-to-impact. You can read a marketing dashboard and tell what's real from what's been dressed up, and you say so. Building the reporting is Marketing Ops' job. Yours is to use it well and push back when it doesn't add up. You hold strategy and execution in the same hand. You can sit in a planning conversation with the VP in the morning and chase down a stuck deliverable in the afternoon, and you don't think the second thing is beneath you. You write clearly and you communicate straight. People trust your readouts because they're honest, not because they're polished. When something is off track, you name it early. You stay calm when it's messy. A marketing org this active will hand you ambiguity every day. Your job is to turn it into a plan other people can actually follow. WHAT YOU'LL OWN OPERATING RHYTHM AND PLANNING Run the marketing org's planning cadence: annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Hold the calendar. Drive budget and headcount planning against the slate, working from Marketing Ops' tracking and reporting, and keep both honest as priorities shift mid-quarter. You own the trade-off conversations; Marketing Ops owns the numbers underneath them. Make the reviews worth holding. Drive the prep, the follow-through, and the decisions that should come out of them. PRIORITIES AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL FLOW Turn the VP of Brand's priorities into plans the team can execute, then hold the line on those priorities when new fires start. Keep major programs from colliding or stalling across brand, editorial, design, product marketing, demand gen, and integrated marketing. A lot of this is seeing the crash coming and preventing it. Be the person teams come to when it isn't clear who owns a decision. CONNECTIVE TISSUE WITH THE REST OF THE COMPANY Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with sales, product, and finance, so the org's commitments are realistic and its dependencies are visible. When marketing promises something to another team, you make sure the promise was sane and gets kept. The systems plumbing behind that (lead routing, scoring, pipeline data) sits with Marketing Ops and RevOps. Your job is the planning and accountability layer on top of it. You'll also chase procurement and legal when purchases and projects stall. LEADERSHIP LEVERAGE Build the materials leadership relies on: board updates, all-hands content, exec readouts. Make them clear and honest, not decorative. Give the VP of Brand back time and attention by carrying the work that doesn't need to land on their desk. SPECIAL PROJECTS Lead the things that don't fit neatly on any one team's plate: a reorg, a new agency relationship, a flagship event, an org-wide planning week. Own them end to end. HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED Planning happens on time and means something. The slate is set, owned, and funded, and people can point to it. Programs ship on cadence without running into each other. Fewer last-minute scrambles, fewer dropped handoffs. Leadership gets time back. The VP of Brand spends more of their week on the calls that need them and less on the ones that don't. Decisions run on the numbers. Reviews and planning work from the org's single source of truth instead of side spreadsheets, and follow-ups actually close. The org feels coherent. People know what they're working on, why it's the priority, and how it connects to the rest of the company. WHAT YOU BRING 10+ years of operating experience, with real time inside a marketing org in a Chief of Staff, business operations, or senior program-operations seat. A practitioner's understanding of demand generation and account-based marketing in a B2B context. You can talk pipeline, not just plans. Comfort with marketing and pipeline metrics and with running a budget. You can build the model and read the dashboard. A track record of bringing order to a fast, complex org without grinding it to a halt. Clear writing, straight talk, and the presence to hold a room of senior people to a plan. BACKGROUNDS WE'D BE EXCITED ABOUT Chief of Staff or business operations at a high-growth B2B software or AI company. A marketing ops or RevOps leader who wants an org-level operating seat rather than a systems seat. Strategy or management consulting followed by an in-house operating role. A demand-gen or integrated-marketing operator who has moved into an org-level operating seat. Cohere is committed to fair and transparent pay practices. title: Payments GTM (Go-to-Market) Operations and Strategy Lead
description: Please note the internal job title is: Principal Payments GTM Operations and Strategy WANT TO BUILD THE GO-TO-MARKET ENGINE FOR A FAST GROWING PAYMENTS BUSINESS? Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead to be part of our Fintech department. Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24. The team: We’re building the financial backbone for field service businesses. Our Fintech team is one of the most strategically important and fastest growing parts of Jobber. We help businesses get paid, access capital, understand their financial health, and ultimately stay in business longer. The future of financial services is embedded, and we’re still early. Small businesses increasingly rely on vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber not just to run their operations, but to manage their money. Payments is the foundation of everything we do in Fintech, and how we go to market with our Get Paid products (invoicing, payments, instant payouts, etc) is the single biggest lever we have to grow the business. This role will own how Jobber’s payments business grows. Think of this as running the commercial side of a payments business inside a SaaS company. The role: Reporting into the VP & GM, Payments and Fintech you will establish Payments GTM Operations as a new function at Jobber. You will bring together every team that touches payments go-to-market (Marketing, Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, Risk, Operations, Analytics, Product Development) and build the programs, processes, and measurement that turn these teams into a coordinated growth engine. The job has two objectives: help more customers discover and get value from Jobber’s payments products, and accelerate revenue growth for the business. Day to day, the Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead will identify opportunities, design programs, and run experiments to drive adoption and usage of Jobber’s payments products. This will include: - Mapping and rebuilding the end-to-end customer journey for payments, from first touch through activation and ongoing usage, working closely with cross-functional partners. This includes identifying where customer-facing teams (sales, post-sales, support) can change their motions to drive better outcomes. - Experimenting with a range of actions (e.g. incentives) to drive payments adoption and usage, rapidly iterating based on results. - Defining the metrics that matter for payments GTM and holding yourself (and cross-functional partners) accountable to them. - Building deep working relationships across GTM teams, Product, RevOps, Analytics, etc. You are the connective tissue between these teams on payments GTM. - Using data and qualitative insights to find opportunities, size them, run experiments, and measure results. - Staying close to what other vertical SaaS and embedded payments players are doing. Knowing where Jobber can differentiate. To be successful, you should have: - Operating and strategy experience, ideally a mix of both: - Operating experience: you have experience identifying opportunities, mobilizing teams, and driving measurable results. Could be Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Strategy & Operations, Product Commercialization, or a GM/Founder role, ideally at a scaling SaaS or Fintech company. - Strategy experience (valued): you have been a strategic partner to senior leaders, making data-driven recommendations. Examples could be Management Consulting, VC, or Strategy & Operations. - Deep understanding of payments and financial services business models, metrics, and growth strategies is desirable, particularly financial services for small businesses. - Strong data instincts. You use analytics to measure impact, make decisions, and optimize performance. You are not just comfortable with data, you reach for it first. - Experience using languages such as SQL to manipulate large data sets is a plus, but not required. - Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across GTM teams, Product, Executive Leadership, etc. You translate data into stories and strategies into action plans. - Demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable operational processes that enhance efficiency and ultimately drive growth. - Passion for helping small businesses succeed through innovative financial solutions. - A curious mind and a growth mindset. You are a scrappy learner who can quickly become an expert and build new capabilities. - A proactive drive to solve problems. You are capable of bringing structure to ambiguous problems, corralling resources, and delivering results. - A preference for working in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment. We’re growing fast and things are changing every day. Location: We believe great collaboration is intentional, and that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect from time to time. This role is open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Employees who live in one of our hub cities - Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo will participate in their department's in-office schedule, while employees outside our hub cities will work remotely. Compensation: At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200 a midpoint of $177,900 and a maximum salary of $204,500 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process! What you can expect from Jobber: - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers. We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. A bit more about us: Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

title: Pilot Success Manager
location: Oakville, Ontario - Canada; Toronto, Ontario - Canada; Waterloo, Ontario - Canada
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
 
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. 

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Pilot Success Manager who will focus on the most strategic accounts across North America and Latin America. The PSM will be the cornerstone of the pre-sale and expansion process for these key accounts, responsible for designing, managing, and executing successful product pilots (Proofs of Concept). If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Pilot Success Manager your key area of responsibility is be the primary driver ensuring that prospective and existing customers experience the full value of the company’s ecosystem, from core telematics solutions to the newest product innovations. By demonstrating tangible ROI and aligning technology with the customer's business objectives, this role plays a pivotal role in securing new business and driving significant account expansion.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead and manage the entire lifecycle of strategic customer pilots for both new business prospects and existing customer expansion opportunities.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to key customer stakeholders. Use pilot data and insights to proactively address concerns, overcome objections, and influence their evaluation criteria to align with Geotab's unique value proposition.

  • Partner with the Business Development Manager during the pilot planning phase to define a strategic approach that directly maps to the prospect's primary business challenges and desired outcomes, ensuring a targeted and impactful evaluation.

  • Collaborate closely with the Sales team, Solutions Engineering, and key customer stakeholders to define clear pilot objectives, success criteria, and key performance indicators (KPIs) that align with the customer's business goals.

  • Develop and execute detailed pilot project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, communication cadences, and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Act as the primary point of contact during the pilot phase, guiding customers through hardware installation, platform configuration, and user training to ensure rapid adoption and value realization.

  • Monitor pilot progress, analyze telematics data, and generate insightful reports. Proactively identify and present findings that demonstrate the value and ROI of Geotab's solutions in the customer's real-world environment.

  •  Serve as the central liaison between the customer and internal Geotab teams, including Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product Management, to ensure a seamless and supportive pilot experience.

  • Expertly manage pilots for Geotab's emerging products and features (e.g., EV solutions, ADAS, new Marketplace integrations), providing critical early-stage feedback to the Product team.

  • Act as one of the first lines of support for any technical challenges during the pilot, effectively triaging issues and coordinating with Solutions Engineering and technical support teams for swift resolution.

  • Prepare and deliver compelling final pilot summary presentations to customer executives, translating technical outcomes into tangible business benefits and providing a clear recommendation for moving forward.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, or Customer Success Management.

  • The ability to quickly grasp a customer's business model, identify their key financial and operational drivers, and articulate how our solutions create tangible business value.

  • Proven experience in a B2B SaaS environment, managing complex projects or technical deployments for large enterprise or strategic accounts.

  • Skilled in applying a consultative, solution-selling methodology to align technology with customer business objectives.

  • Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously.

  • Strong technical acumen and the ability to quickly learn and articulate complex hardware and software solutions.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently engage with a wide range of stakeholders, from fleet managers to C-level executives.

  • Data-driven and analytical mindset; comfortable working with data to uncover trends and prove value.

  • Experience managing Proof of Concepts (PoCs) or technical trials in a pre-sales capacity.

  • A proactive, problem-solving attitude with a relentless focus on customer success and achieving objectives.

  • Ability to travel occasionally to customer sites across North America.

  • Direct experience in the telematics, fleet management, logistics, or IoT industries is a nice to have.

  • Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese considered an asset.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
 
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.
 
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Flex working arrangements
Home office reimbursement program
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program
Online learning and networking opportunities
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

*The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Click here to read our Privacy Notice.

title: Pricing & Packaging Director
description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We’re looking for a Pricing & Packaging Director who has a strong SaaS and cloud service pricing background, a firm grasp of value based pricing, understands how to achieve growth objectives through pricing strategy, and is adept at leading, influencing, and inspiring collaboration across cross-functional teams. In this role, you will partner directly with GTM Leadership, Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Management, and Finance to help define and deliver the next generation of pricing and packaging for 1Password’s product portfolio. You will be accountable for developing and executing pricing strategies for new and existing products, designing new packaging options and customer upgrade paths, and evaluating pricing performance. You will be responsible for establishing the optimal features of each package. You will develop the price and discount curves for our growing portfolio of products, accounting for external factors such as customer and competitor behavior, market trends, and internal factors such as COGS and margin goals. Your primary measures of success will be ARR maximization, customer lifetime value optimization, and margin attainment. You will thrive at 1Password if you have a thirst to win and see pricing and packaging as a strategic tool in our GTM toolkit. The scope of this role traverses a broad range of customer segments – from large enterprises, mid-sized and small businesses to individual consumers. Mastery of SaaS pricing models, exceptional analytical skills, and a track record of driving and executing upon successful monetization strategies across a diverse array of segments, industries, and regions is a non-negotiable requirement for this role. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What you can expect: - Collaborate closely with senior leadership to create pricing and packaging strategies that unlock significant incremental new business and expansion ARR growth. - Identify and understand customer value drivers through market research, segmentation, and customer willingness to pay. - Lead the collection and analysis of market data, industry trends, and pricing competitive intelligence to inform strategic decision-making and go-to-market strategies. - Refine pricing and packaging models for new and existing products aligned with 1Password growth and profitability goals. - Lead the repackaging of the B2B offering with multi-tier packaging to capture value up and down the market. - Partner with product marketing to create the packaging and pricing for new products during the new product launch process. Assess market and customer price sensitivity, competitor pricing, and 1Password financial objectives in new and adjacent categories to establish initial pricing, and test pricing post-launch. - Develop the pricing strategy to support the sales of our core products through distributors, resellers, and MSPs in North America, EMEA, and APJ. - Create pricing and packaging options for monetizing advanced support and/or professional services offerings. - Evaluate opportunities to lower or raise pricing in B2C and B2B offers to maximize market share capture and customer lifetime value. - Partner with product and technology teams to simplify and improve the efficiencies of product-led growth (PLG) self-service renewal motion, incentivizing upgrades to the next product tier and optimizing renewal rates. - Develop a programmatic promotions framework in partnership with GTM, and then deliver promotions to accelerate and unblock new business pipeline, incentivize expansion and renewals, and make it simple for current customers to adopt new products when launched. - Formalize pricing operations and establish durable pricing guidelines and a governance model. Deliver a method to experiment with pricing or packaging over time. - Assess operational and alignment issues with historical and current pricing and packaging, develop a roadmap to reduce the ‘legacy pricing and packaging debt’ over time, then prioritize and execute the work. - Iterate and optimize the portfolio of product and services packages to complement additions and enhancements to the product suite in order to ensure customers are successful throughout their lifecycle. - Deliver regular updates to executive leadership, offering actionable proposals and recommendations based on market intelligence, competitive intelligence and Voice of Customer insights. - Train organization on new pricing and packaging through direct participation in Billing and Revenue Operations team meetings, GTM enablement sessions, and town hall meeting presentations. - Act as the primary point of contact for all pricing questions for cross functional teams, partners and analysts. What we're looking for - 10+ years in pricing, strategy, finance, or a combination of relevant functions with in-depth knowledge of SaaS business models and subscription pricing - Hands-on experience with proven impact developing pricing and packaging strategies that maximize revenue and profitability across new and existing products, and across a range of customer segments. - Experience across North America, EMEA, and APJ markets and with direct-to-consumer, PLG and sales-driven GTM motions. - Deep experience working with finance teams to develop financial models that evaluate product margins and the impact of pricing changes on ARR and LTV - Exceptional analytical skills and comfort working with quantitative and qualitative analyses, financial modeling, sensitivity analyses, pricing studies, and pricing research. - Excellent business acumen to evaluate and analyze key business drivers, risks and opportunities. - Strong collaborator able to influence cross-functional teams and leverage partners across product, marketing, sales, finance, and data to execute the work that activates the pricing and packaging strategy. - Effective communicator that can drive a clear narrative on pricing analyses and recommendations for an executive leadership audience, building consensus and resolving conflict across all levels of the organization. - A strategist and operator that can translate strategy into actionable plans, and also guide a team to efficiently execute on those plans in an ambiguous and high-growth environment. - Growth mindset that continuously evaluates and refines approaches based on feedback to ultimately maximize impact and effectiveness for the business, customers and the people you work with. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $176,000 USD and $264,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $160,000CAD and $240,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs 🩺 Competitive health benefits 🏝 Generous PTO policy Growth and future 📈 RSU program for most employees 💸 Retirement matching program 🔑 Free 1Password account Community 🤝 Paid volunteer days 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 🌎 Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law. 1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. title: Principal Product Manager, Financial Products
location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Toronto, ON
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Faire's financial products are among the most powerful and differentiated value props we offer — and among the most consequential for both sides of our marketplace. We extend net-60 and net-90 payment terms to retailers on behalf of brands, offer the Faire Pay credit card with 3% back on purchases, and are actively building brand financing. These products do something our partners simply cannot do on their own: absorb risk, deploy capital efficiently, and unlock purchasing behavior that drives growth across the platform.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the entire Financial Products portfolio — someone who can run disciplined day-to-day execution while simultaneously developing the longer-term strategic roadmap for how financial products evolve as a core business line. This means thinking clearly about unit economics and cost of capital, building conviction around where Faire has durable competitive advantages, and shipping products that move real business metrics.

What you'll do

  • Own strategy and roadmap for Faire's financial products. Set the multi-year direction for how Faire Pay, net terms, brand financing, and future financial products evolve, and build the prioritized, financially grounded roadmap to get there.
  • Drive Faire Pay adoption and marketplace impact. Expand the invited retailer cohort, improve activation and retention across the funnel, and demonstrate that financial products are a meaningful growth lever for the core marketplace, not just a standalone offering.
  • Own the unit economics. Think in contribution margin, cost of capital, and payback periods. Optimize interchange, manage loss rates, and identify where structural advantages exist versus where we need to earn our way in.
  • Partner deeply across Finance, Risk, Legal, Data Science, and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving without losing momentum.
  • Build the infrastructure for scale. Partner to develop the data infrastructure, risk frameworks, and operational foundations needed to grow financial products responsibly, from underwriting logic to regulatory compliance.
  • Communicate clearly at every altitude. Translate complex, technical topics (cost of capital, credit risk, underwriting tradeoffs) for a wide range of audiences, from engineering partners to senior leadership.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated ability to own complex, cross-functional products end to end.
  • You've built and shipped financial products — credit, lending, payments, BNPL, or similar — and you understand the mechanics: underwriting logic, cost of capital, credit risk, contribution margin, and regulatory constraints. You don't need to be a finance expert, but you need to be able to lead the room.
  • Business equation fluency. You think comfortably in unit economics. You can model whether a new product makes sense given Faire's cost of capital, estimate cohort-level payback periods, and identify structural advantages worth betting on.
  • Strategic clarity with hands-on execution. You can zoom out and develop a defensible multi-year point of view, then zoom back in to write crisp PRDs, drive sprint-level execution, and unblock your team. 
  • Customer and business model empathy. You deeply understand how retailers and brands run their businesses — their cash flow cycles, how they think about credit and payment terms, and what makes them trust a financial product. You design around customer needs, not just what's technically feasible.
  • Cross-functional influence across Finance, Risk, Legal, Data Science, and Engineering, and a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders while maintaining momentum.
  • Structured problem solving. You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, don't mistake activity for progress, and diagnose root causes rather than escalate.
  • High learning velocity. Financial products sit at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, risk, and regulatory complexity. 
  • Proven ability to influence at the executive level and to communicate complex topics with clarity and conviction across audiences.
  • B2B marketplace experience is a strong plus — particularly familiarity with two-sided dynamics, competing customer objectives, and the structural differences between B2B and consumer credit.

Salary Range

San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $260,000 - $357,500 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors, including transferable skills, work experience, market demand, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.
